card.name: "Change in" before metabolic measures
card.fires_on: The word "in" (or "total") right after "mean change" or "change" in antipsychotic safety summaries. It comes just before a lab or weight measure such as weight, glucose or cholesterol.

modes.label: Change in + measure
modes.description: The word "in" right after "mean change" or "Change", before weight, glucose or lipids.
modes.example: patients who received lurasidone hydrochloride tablets as monotherapy in the short-term and continued in the longer-term study had a mean change<< in>> weight of -0.02 kg

modes.label: Total before cholesterol
modes.description: The word "total" after "change in", leading into cholesterol and triglycerides.
modes.example: patients who received lurasidone hydrochloride tablets as monotherapy in the short-term and continued in the longer-term study had a mean change in<< total>> cholesterol and triglycerides of -0
